lead.headline: U.S. strikes Iran's Qeshm Island as Tehran's drones hit Bahrain and Kuwait
lead.summary: U.S. jets hit a Revolutionary Guard missile site on Qeshm Island after Iranian drones targeted a U.S. radar base in Bahrain. Tehran then fired drones at Bahrain and Kuwait as Gulf tensions surge.

stories.headline: Kerch Bridge to Crimea partly collapses after Ukrainian strikes
stories.summary: A road span fell into the strait on the second day of attacks; rail service later resumed.

stories.headline: Ebola in DR Congo more than doubles in three months
stories.summary: The UN counts 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths; three in four infected children under five die.

stories.headline: U.S. loses measles-free status after 26 years
stories.summary: PAHO ends the status held since 2000 — 5,412 cases, 10 deaths, the worst outbreak since 1991.

stories.headline: Peltola wins Alaska; Democrats reach 56 Senate seats
stories.summary: Mary Peltola unseats Republican Dan Sullivan, flipping the ninth seat for a 56–44 majority.
